snippet.title: Fear The Timeloop - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Fear The Timeloop, a third-person psychological horror adventure game developed by TacoEaters. Players will find themselves trapped in a 15-minute loop as a dying Sheriff named James Cooper. Explore a decaying hospital, take out sinister enemies, and break the loop for good in Fear The Timeloop, launching on January 30 for PC (Steam).
